observations: Photo 0 shows a boxed/packaged Sony-branded item (visible 'SONY' on the right side).
The item appears to be a console in retail packaging with protective plastic wrap.
No Xbox branding, model number, or controller/pad is clearly visible in the photo.

read_from: photo 0 (brand text 'SONY' visible, but console model not readable)

claims.claim: Uk used xbox one Console with games installed and accessories except pad
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show Xbox One branding, the console model, installed games, or the listed accessories; it only shows a Sony-branded packaged console.

risks.risk: The console may not be an Xbox One (photo shows Sony branding, which could indicate PlayStation instead).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console front/back labels showing the exact model (Xbox One vs PlayStation) and the ports/model sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst case for the buyer’s intent: treat as not-confirmed Xbox One (assume mismatch/unknown console), so value should be at the low end until identity is proven.

risks.risk: Games installed claim cannot be verified from the photo; could be no games or different region/account.
risks.proof: A video/clip of the console booting to the dashboard and showing the installed games list (or storage/game library screen).

risks.risk: Accessories 'except pad' may be incomplete or different from what’s expected (power cable, HDMI, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included accessory with labels (power brick/cable, HDMI, headset, cables) and what is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no confirmed accessories).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be faulty, overheating, disc drive issues, or missing parts).
risks.proof: A short test clip: console powers on, loads a game/app, and shows no error messages.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the console model/label (front/back and the sticker) to confirm Xbox One specifically.
Video showing the dashboard and the installed games list (or storage/game library screen).
Photos of all included accessories laid out (and confirm the exact missing item: controller/pad).
Power-on and quick functional test clip (no errors; loads a game/app).
response.reason: The photo shows a Sony-branded packaged console, which conflicts with the seller’s claim of an Xbox One, and the installed games/accessories/working status are not verifiable from the single image. Proof of exact model and functionality is required before pricing.
